b_01KX97VYHMNDCHZB0Z5M3NJMEZ.subject: job_type_mismatch_likely_error
b_01KX97VYHMNDCHZB0Z5M3NJMEZ.content: Assigning an 'Addition' job definition to a bathroom remodel project is almost certainly a data entry error. Home Addition planning (10–16 weeks, foundation, framing, permits) is materially different from a bathroom remodel (4–8 weeks) and will produce incorrect estimation, scheduling, and template outputs if left uncorrected.
b_01KX97VYHMNDCHZB0Z5M3NJMEZ.falsification_test: Would be wrong if the customer has requested a home addition in addition to the bathroom remodel, and this job represents a separate planned phase on the same property.

b_01KX97VYHMNVKE3B3MFJTA6T5G.subject: job_early_unconfigured
b_01KX97VYHMNVKE3B3MFJTA6T5G.content: The job is fully unconfigured — no valuation, no start date, no scope or breakdown documents, status 'waiting_diagnosis' — consistent with the parent project's pre-contract stage.
b_01KX97VYHMNVKE3B3MFJTA6T5G.falsification_test: Would be wrong if 'waiting_diagnosis' is a terminal or deliberate hold state unrelated to project maturity.
